title: 彭博：全球机场为何难舍吸烟室？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: There's one place in the world that can't seem to quit smoking.
segments.zh: 世界上有一个地方似乎无法戒烟。

segments.en: Airports. Over the years, cigarettes have been forced out of public spaces.
segments.zh: 机场。多年来，香烟已被赶出公共场所。
餐厅、酒吧、工作场所，甚至海滩。

segments.en: But indoor smoking rooms are still allowed in more than 100 countries.
segments.zh: 但室内吸烟室在100多个国家仍被允许。

segments.en: These spaces feel like relics from the past.
segments.zh: 这些空间感觉像是过去的遗物。

segments.en: But they also function as anomalies in countries where hostility to smoking has only grown.
segments.zh: 但在对吸烟敌意日益增长的国家，它们也是异类。

segments.en: The Swiss may be banned from smoking at outdoor bus stops in Geneva.
segments.zh: 日内瓦的户外公交站禁止吸烟。

segments.en: But as Zurich Airport, the country's largest, they can choose from 16 smoking areas, all of them indoors.
segments.zh: 但在该国最大的苏黎世机场，有16个室内吸烟区可供选择。

segments.en: For years, airports have pointed to passenger demand as the reason smoking areas still exist.
segments.zh: 多年来，机场一直以乘客需求为由保留吸烟区。

segments.en: But anti-smoking groups say that airport smoking room is evidence of the lingering influence of the tobacco industry.
segments.zh: 但反吸烟组织表示，机场吸烟室是烟草业持续影响的证据。

segments.en: Japan, tobacco international, which operates the camel, subrani and Winston brands outside of the US, says it has approximately 70 lounges around the world
segments.zh: 日本烟草国际公司运营着骆驼、苏布拉尼和温斯顿品牌，在全球约有70间吸烟、电子烟及加热烟草产品休息室。

segments.en: for smoking, vaping, and its heated tobacco products.
segments.zh: 供吸烟、电子烟及加热烟草产品使用。

segments.en: Doctors argue there is no justification for airport smoking rooms, especially now that smokers can rely on nicotine patches, or gum, while travelling.
segments.zh: 医生认为机场吸烟室没有存在的理由，尤其是现在旅客可以使用尼古丁贴片或口香糖。

segments.en: But alternative nicotine products, especially vapes, threaten to bolster demand for airport smoking rooms instead of eliminating it.
segments.zh: 但替代尼古丁产品，尤其是电子烟，反而可能增加对机场吸烟室的需求，而非消除它。

segments.en: Zurich has two dedicated vaping rooms.
segments.zh: 苏黎世机场设有两个专用电子烟室。
